gauge.name: Rio Fajardo near Fajardo

impacts.statement: Flooding will reach Calle Doctor Lopez, near Casa Alcaldia. Calle Colon, Calle Progreso, the intersection of road PR-194 and Avenue Marcelito Gotay, Calle Munoz Rivera, Cll Iglesia will be impassable. -erg 05/2025

Flooding along Calle Progreso and Calle Colon. Flooding could reach the lowest two houses in Calle Colon, with about a foot of water entering the structures. These roads will become impassable.- erg 05/2025
PR-194 will become impassable, near the intersection with Calle Marcelito Gotay./ erg-04/29/2025
Rio Fajardo will overflow through the drainage along PR-194, km 0.6, with ponding of water on the lanes. /ERG 05/2024

properties.caption: The USGS sensor, FAJP4, located adjacent to a bridge. In the picture, the green box, solar panel and antenna are visible. There are bamboos in the river just behind the bridge.
A view of the USGS sensor, FAJP4, from the river bed. The sensor is radar like. The streamflow is flowing unobstructed below the bridge.

gauge.forecastReliability: Forecasts are not available. Only observed stages are available for this point.
